literal_meaning: মাদারির খেলা বা নাটক (madari's play or performance)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মাদারির খেল করে সবাইকে ধোঁকা দিল।
রাজনীতিতে এই মাদারির খেল চলছে অনেকদিন।
example_sentences_in_english: He played a madari's trick to deceive everyone.
This sleight of hand has been going on in politics for years.
history: Refers to the deceptive performances by madaris, traditional itinerant entertainers in Bengali culture who use tricks with animals and illusions.
note: Madari often implies snake charmers or jugglers in rural Bengali folklore.
